WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS category_as_was, p.subcategory AS sub_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, n.category_as_was, cp.category AS category_as_is,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND (n.category_as_was = 'Garden' OR cp.category = 'Garden' OR n.sub_was ILIKE '%light%')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY 2,3,4

SELECT 'sales' AS t, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_distinct_rl,
       min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-20' AND DATE '2025-05-10'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-20' AND DATE '2025-05-10'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND r.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.mine, c.ctrl, m.mine - c.ctrl AS gap FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
